title: The Three Words That Saved My Life | Blake Mycoskie | TED
speaker: TED
zh: 【TED】拯救我生命的三個字|布萊克麥考斯基 |泰德（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: When I started TOMS Shoes, I lived on a 45-foot sailboat in Marina del Rey.
cues.en: When I started TOMS Shoes, I lived on a 45-foot sailboat in Marina del Rey.
cues.zh: 當我創辦 TOMS Shoes 時，我住在瑪麗安德爾灣 (Marina del Rey) 的一艘 45 英尺長的帆船上。

cues.text: I didn't have much -- a few bags of clothes, a bike, a surfboard and a laptop.
cues.en: I didn't have much -- a few bags of clothes, a bike, a surfboard and a laptop.
cues.zh: 我沒有太多東西——幾袋衣服、一輛腳踏車、一個衝浪板和一臺筆記型電腦。

cues.text: That was it.
cues.en: That was it.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.text: And those were some of the happiest years of my life.
cues.en: And those were some of the happiest years of my life.
cues.zh: 那是我一生中最快樂的幾年。

cues.text: I woke up to the ocean rocking me.
cues.en: I woke up to the ocean rocking me.
cues.zh: 我醒來時發現大海在搖晃我。

cues.text: I made coffee barefoot.
cues.en: I made coffee barefoot.
cues.zh: 我赤腳煮咖啡。

cues.text: I felt clear, inspired and alive.
cues.en: I felt clear, inspired and alive.
cues.zh: 我感覺清晰、充滿靈感、充滿活力。

cues.text: Now let’s fast-forward 20 years.
cues.en: Now let’s fast-forward 20 years.
cues.zh: 現在讓我們快進 20 年。

cues.text: TOMS had become a global brand.
cues.en: TOMS had become a global brand.
cues.zh: TOMS 已成為一個全球品牌。

cues.text: Our one-for-one model had given over 100 million shoes
cues.en: Our one-for-one model had given over 100 million shoes
cues.zh: 我們的買一送一模式已送出超過一億雙鞋

cues.text: to children in need around the world.
cues.en: to children in need around the world.
cues.zh: 為世界各地有需要的兒童。

cues.text: And personally, I had made more money than I ever thought was possible.
cues.en: And personally, I had made more money than I ever thought was possible.
cues.zh: 就我個人而言，我賺的錢比我想像的還要多。

cues.text: And yet, 23 months ago, I had become so lost,
cues.en: And yet, 23 months ago, I had become so lost,
cues.zh: 然而，23個月前，我變得如此迷失，

cues.text: so hopeless and so depressed that I made a plan to end my life.
cues.en: so hopeless and so depressed that I made a plan to end my life.
cues.zh: 我如此絕望和沮喪，以至於我制定了結束生命的計劃。

cues.text: And I chose that boat as the place to do it on Not because I wanted to die there,
cues.en: And I chose that boat as the place to do it on Not because I wanted to die there,
cues.zh: 我選擇那艘船作為做這件事的地方 不是因為我想死在那裡，

cues.text: but because I didn't want my family to be the ones who found me.
cues.en: but because I didn't want my family to be the ones who found me.
cues.zh: 但因為我不想讓我的家人找到我

cues.text: Knowing that I was going to say that today, here on the stage, is definitely the hardest part of preparing for this talk.
cues.en: Knowing that I was going to say that today, here on the stage, is definitely the hardest part of preparing for this talk.
cues.zh: 知道我今天要說的，在臺上，絕對是準備這場演講最困難的部分。

cues.text: Thankfully, I did not act on that plan.
cues.en: Thankfully, I did not act on that plan.
cues.zh: 值得慶幸的是，我沒有按照這個計劃行事。

cues.text: Instead, I reached out to my friends and my family
cues.en: Instead, I reached out to my friends and my family
cues.zh: 相反，我聯絡了我的朋友和家人

cues.text: and I told them the truth.
cues.en: and I told them the truth.
cues.zh: 我告訴了他們真相。

cues.text: Not that I was stressed, not that I lost my purpose.
cues.en: Not that I was stressed, not that I lost my purpose.
cues.zh: 並不是我有壓力，也不是我失去了目標。

cues.text: I told them I wasn’t OK -- and that decision saved my life.
cues.en: I told them I wasn’t OK -- and that decision saved my life.
cues.zh: 我告訴他們我不太好——這個決定救了我的命。

cues.text: I then met an incredible psychiatrist who helped me really slow down and understand how I got there.
cues.en: I then met an incredible psychiatrist who helped me really slow down and understand how I got there.
cues.zh: 然後我遇到了一位令人難以置信的精神科醫生，他幫助我真正放慢速度並瞭解我是如何到達那裡的。

cues.text: Not just what I was feeling, but why.
cues.en: Not just what I was feeling, but why.
cues.zh: 不僅僅是我的感受，還有為什麼。

cues.text: We then spent five months weaning me off four different medications
cues.en: We then spent five months weaning me off four different medications
cues.zh: 然後我們花了五個月的時間讓我戒掉四種不同的藥物

cues.text: I had been put on when I was misdiagnosed as bipolar.
cues.en: I had been put on when I was misdiagnosed as bipolar.
cues.zh: 當我被誤診為雙極性情感障礙時，我就被戴上了。

cues.text: Five months.
cues.en: Five months.
cues.zh: 五個月。

cues.text: And during that time, the anxiety did not get better --
cues.en: And during that time, the anxiety did not get better --
cues.zh: 在那段時間裡，焦慮並沒有好轉——

cues.text: it got worse.
cues.en: it got worse.
cues.zh: 情況變得更糟了。

cues.text: And the racing thoughts in my head almost became unbearable.
cues.en: And the racing thoughts in my head almost became unbearable.
cues.zh: 我腦子裡的思緒幾乎快要難以忍受了。

cues.text: But eventually, my mind started to settle, and something became impossible to ignore.
cues.en: But eventually, my mind started to settle, and something became impossible to ignore.
cues.zh: 但最終，我的思緒開始安定下來，有些事情變得無法忽視。

cues.text: There was a core wound underneath it all ...
cues.en: There was a core wound underneath it all ...
cues.zh: 在它的下面有一個核心傷口...

cues.text: a very, very old one.
cues.en: a very, very old one.
cues.zh: 一個非常非常古老的。

cues.text: And it said this: "You are not enough."
cues.en: And it said this: "You are not enough."
cues.zh: 它說：“你還不夠。”

cues.text: The truth is, I had never felt that I was enough.
cues.en: The truth is, I had never felt that I was enough.
cues.zh: 事實是，我從來沒有覺得自己夠了。

cues.text: Not as a kid, not as an athlete,
cues.en: Not as a kid, not as an athlete,
cues.zh: 不是作為一個孩子，不是作為一個運動員，

cues.text: not as a founder, not as a human.
cues.en: not as a founder, not as a human.
cues.zh: 不是作為創始人，不是作為人。

cues.text: And when I looked honestly at my life, I saw something that was really painful.
cues.en: And when I looked honestly at my life, I saw something that was really painful.
cues.zh: 當我誠實地審視自己的生活時，我看到了一些非常痛苦的事情。

cues.text: Everything I had done for the first 48 years
cues.en: Everything I had done for the first 48 years
cues.zh: 前48年我所做的一切

cues.text: was an attempt to earn my worth --
cues.en: was an attempt to earn my worth --
cues.zh: 是為了贏得我的價值——

cues.text: becoming a championship tennis player, starting multiple businesses,
cues.en: becoming a championship tennis player, starting multiple businesses,
cues.zh: 成為冠軍網球運動員，創辦許多企業，

cues.text: building TOMS and becoming the poster child of conscious capitalism.
cues.en: building TOMS and becoming the poster child of conscious capitalism.
cues.zh: 建立 TOMS 並成為自覺資本主義的典範。

cues.text: I mean, there were the magazine covers, the stages just like this one,
cues.en: I mean, there were the magazine covers, the stages just like this one,
cues.zh: 我的意思是，有雜誌封面，舞臺就像這個，

cues.text: the awards and the accolades, because I believed that achievement would quiet that voice.
cues.en: the awards and the accolades, because I believed that achievement would quiet that voice.
cues.zh: 獎項和榮譽，因為我相信成就會讓那個聲音安靜下來。

cues.text: Instead, it made it louder.
cues.en: Instead, it made it louder.
cues.zh: 相反，它讓聲音變得更大。

cues.text: And it got so loud inside my mind that I didn't want to be alive anymore.
cues.en: And it got so loud inside my mind that I didn't want to be alive anymore.
cues.zh: 它在我的腦海裡變得如此響亮，以至於我不想再活了。

cues.text: But one day, during a deep healing session with my therapist,
cues.en: But one day, during a deep healing session with my therapist,
cues.zh: 但有一天，在與我的治療師進行深度治療時，

cues.text: something finally shifted.
cues.en: something finally shifted.
cues.zh: 有些東西終於改變了。

cues.text: I began to see my life not as a success story, but as a strategy.
cues.en: I began to see my life not as a success story, but as a strategy.
cues.zh: 我開始不再將自己的生活視為一個成功的故事，而是一種策略。

cues.text: A strategy to earn worth.
cues.en: A strategy to earn worth.
cues.zh: 賺取價值的策略。

cues.text: And when that strategy failed, my whole world had collapsed.
cues.en: And when that strategy failed, my whole world had collapsed.
cues.zh: 當這個策略失敗時，我的整個世界都崩潰了。

cues.text: So my therapist suggested something one day that honestly sounded ridiculous at first.
cues.en: So my therapist suggested something one day that honestly sounded ridiculous at first.
cues.zh: 所以有一天，我的治療師提出了一些起初聽起來很荒謬的建議。

cues.text: He said, “Blake, for over 40 years your mind has been telling you that you’re not enough,
cues.en: He said, “Blake, for over 40 years your mind has been telling you that you’re not enough,
cues.zh: 他說：「布萊克，四十多年來，你的大腦一直在告訴你，你還不夠，

cues.text: so you are going to live with this limiting belief
cues.en: so you are going to live with this limiting belief
cues.zh: 所以你將忍受這種限制性的信念

cues.text: the rest of your life, unless we reprogram your subconscious
cues.en: the rest of your life, unless we reprogram your subconscious
cues.zh: 你的餘生，除非我們重新程式設計你的潛意識

cues.text: and rewire your neural pathways." So we made a commitment for the next 40 days.
cues.en: and rewire your neural pathways." So we made a commitment for the next 40 days.
cues.zh: 並重新連結你的神經通路。 「因此我們做出了未來 40 天的承諾。

cues.text: I would wake up every morning, immediately sit up in bed,
cues.en: I would wake up every morning, immediately sit up in bed,
cues.zh: 每天早上醒來，立刻從床上坐起來，

cues.text: and repeat one sentence over and over again,
cues.en: and repeat one sentence over and over again,
cues.zh: 並一遍又一遍地重複一句話，

cues.text: for 20 minutes, with my eyes closed.
cues.en: for 20 minutes, with my eyes closed.
cues.zh: 20分鐘，閉上眼睛。

cues.text: "I am enough, I've always been enough." And then, before going to bed later that night,
cues.en: "I am enough, I've always been enough." And then, before going to bed later that night,
cues.zh: 「我就夠了，我一直都夠了。」然後，那天晚上睡覺前，

cues.text: I would do it again.
cues.en: I would do it again.
cues.zh: 我會再做一次。

cues.text: "I am enough, I've always been enough." 20 minutes in the morning,
cues.en: "I am enough, I've always been enough." 20 minutes in the morning,
cues.zh: 「我就夠了，我一直都夠了。」早上20分鐘，

cues.text: 20 minutes at night, for 40 days.
cues.en: 20 minutes at night, for 40 days.
cues.zh: 晚上20分鐘，持續40天。

cues.text: Now the first few weeks, honestly, were brutal.
cues.en: Now the first few weeks, honestly, were brutal.
cues.zh: 老實說，最初的幾週是殘酷的。

cues.text: 20 minutes felt like two hours, and the whole practice felt so trivial.
cues.en: 20 minutes felt like two hours, and the whole practice felt so trivial.
cues.zh: 20分鐘感覺就像兩個小時一樣，整個練習感覺很瑣碎。

cues.text: After three weeks, I didn't feel any different.
cues.en: After three weeks, I didn't feel any different.
cues.zh: 三個星期後，我沒有感覺到任何不同。

cues.text: So I almost quit and changed therapists.
cues.en: So I almost quit and changed therapists.
cues.zh: 所以我幾乎辭職並換了治療師。

cues.text: But I was so damn desperate to feel better,
cues.en: But I was so damn desperate to feel better,
cues.zh: 但我真的非常渴望感覺好一點

cues.text: and nothing else had worked, so I decided to stick with it.
cues.en: and nothing else had worked, so I decided to stick with it.
cues.zh: 但其他方法都不起作用，所以我決定堅持下去。

cues.text: And on the 28th day, around there, I was sitting up in bed, saying the words,
cues.en: And on the 28th day, around there, I was sitting up in bed, saying the words,
cues.zh: 第 28 天，就在那裡，我坐在床上，說：

cues.text: and all of a sudden, I felt almost, like, an electric shock go through my body,
cues.en: and all of a sudden, I felt almost, like, an electric shock go through my body,
cues.zh: 突然之間，我幾乎感覺，就像電擊穿過我的身體，

cues.text: and a lightness and a peace I had never felt.
cues.en: and a lightness and a peace I had never felt.
cues.zh: 以及一種我從未感受過的輕鬆與平靜。

cues.text: And what had been a generic mantra for the past couple of weeks actually felt true.
cues.en: And what had been a generic mantra for the past couple of weeks actually felt true.
cues.zh: 過去幾週的通用口號實際上感覺是真實的。

cues.text: "I am enough, and I always have been." Not because of what I've done, not because of what I've built,
cues.en: "I am enough, and I always have been." Not because of what I've done, not because of what I've built,
cues.zh: 「我就夠了，而且一直都是。」不是因為我所做的事，不是因為我建造的東西，

cues.text: and definitely not because of what the world thinks of me,
cues.en: and definitely not because of what the world thinks of me,
cues.zh: 絕對不是因為世界對我的看法，

cues.text: but just because I exist.
cues.en: but just because I exist.
cues.zh: 但只是因為我存在。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。

cues.text: And when that stopped being something I said out loud and something I felt in my body,
cues.en: And when that stopped being something I said out loud and something I felt in my body,
cues.zh: 當這不再是我大聲說出來的事情和我身體裡感覺到的事情時，

cues.text: everything changed.
cues.en: everything changed.
cues.zh: 一切都變了。

cues.text: I simplified my life again.
cues.en: I simplified my life again.
cues.zh: 我再次簡化了我的生活。

cues.text: I stripped away the noise, and I stopped performing.
cues.en: I stripped away the noise, and I stopped performing.
cues.zh: 我消除了噪音，停止了表演。

cues.text: And I realized this: If I spend decades trying to earn my worth,
cues.en: And I realized this: If I spend decades trying to earn my worth,
cues.zh: 我意識到這一點：如果我花幾十年的時間努力贏得自己的價值，

cues.text: and if I could almost lose my life ...
cues.en: and if I could almost lose my life ...
cues.zh: 如果我差點失去生命的話…

cues.text: trying to earn it, then this wound is everywhere,
cues.en: trying to earn it, then this wound is everywhere,
cues.zh: 試圖贏得它，然後這個傷口無處不在，

cues.text: and no one is immune to it.
cues.en: and no one is immune to it.
cues.zh: 沒有人能夠倖免。

cues.text: Right now, when someone experiences anxiety, depression or a mental illness,
cues.en: Right now, when someone experiences anxiety, depression or a mental illness,
cues.zh: 現在，當有人經歷焦慮、憂鬱或精神疾病時，

cues.text: we treat it like a shocking failure, like something went wrong.
cues.en: we treat it like a shocking failure, like something went wrong.
cues.zh: 我們把它當作一次令人震驚的失敗，就像出了什麼問題。

cues.text: But think about physical illness.
cues.en: But think about physical illness.
cues.zh: 但想想身體疾病。

cues.text: We expect it.
cues.en: We expect it.
cues.zh: 我們期待它。

cues.text: We expect colds, we expect broken bones.
cues.en: We expect colds, we expect broken bones.
cues.zh: 我們預計會感冒，我們預計會骨折。

cues.text: We plan for them, we talk about them.
cues.en: We plan for them, we talk about them.
cues.zh: 我們為他們計劃，我們談論他們。

cues.text: But mental illness?
cues.en: But mental illness?
cues.zh: 但精神疾病呢？

cues.text: We whisper.
cues.en: We whisper.
cues.zh: 我們竊竊私語。

cues.text: We isolate.
cues.en: We isolate.
cues.zh: 我們隔離。

cues.text: We pretend that we are fine.
cues.en: We pretend that we are fine.
cues.zh: 我們假裝我們很好。

cues.text: And I'm telling you that silence is deadly.
cues.en: And I'm telling you that silence is deadly.
cues.zh: 我告訴你，沉默是致命的。

cues.text: I almost became part of a statistic.
cues.en: I almost became part of a statistic.
cues.zh: 我幾乎成為統計資料的一部分。

cues.text: Not because I was weak, but because I was too ashamed to tell my friends how I was really doing.
cues.en: Not because I was weak, but because I was too ashamed to tell my friends how I was really doing.
cues.zh: 不是因為我軟弱，而是因為我羞於告訴我的朋友我的真實狀況。

cues.text: Today, I'd like to ask everyone here two questions.
cues.en: Today, I'd like to ask everyone here two questions.
cues.zh: 今天想問大家兩個問題。

cues.text: Please raise your hand if you have ever broken a bone.
cues.en: Please raise your hand if you have ever broken a bone.
cues.zh: 如果您骨折過，請舉手。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。

cues.text: So it looks like about 40 percent of the room, which is interesting,
cues.en: So it looks like about 40 percent of the room, which is interesting,
cues.zh: 所以看起來大約是房間的 40%，這很​​有趣，

cues.text: because that's what my dad, who's actually an orthopedic surgeon, said it would be,
cues.en: because that's what my dad, who's actually an orthopedic surgeon, said it would be,
cues.zh: 因為我父親（其實是整形外科醫生）是這麼說的，

cues.text: so he got that one right.
cues.en: so he got that one right.
cues.zh: 所以他做對了。

cues.text: A harder question now.
cues.en: A harder question now.
cues.zh: 現在是一個更難的問題。

cues.text: If you've ever been diagnosed with severe anxiety,
cues.en: If you've ever been diagnosed with severe anxiety,
cues.zh: 如果您曾經被診斷出患有嚴重焦慮症，

cues.text: depression, bipolar disorder or a mental health condition,
cues.en: depression, bipolar disorder or a mental health condition,
cues.zh: 憂鬱症、躁鬱症或精神健康狀況，

cues.text: would you please raise your hand?
cues.en: would you please raise your hand?
cues.zh: 請舉手好嗎？

cues.text: Thank you for your bravery.
cues.en: Thank you for your bravery.
cues.zh: 謝謝你的勇敢。

cues.text: Notice, a lot fewer hands went up.
cues.en: Notice, a lot fewer hands went up.
cues.zh: 請注意，舉手的人少了很多。

cues.text: But according to the US Department of Health,
cues.en: But according to the US Department of Health,
cues.zh: 但據美國衛生部稱，

cues.text: we should have seen about the same number of hands for both questions.
cues.en: we should have seen about the same number of hands for both questions.
cues.zh: 我們應該看到這兩個問題的手數大致相同。

cues.text: In fact, 50 percent of all people will be diagnosed with a mental health condition
cues.en: In fact, 50 percent of all people will be diagnosed with a mental health condition
cues.zh: 事實上，50% 的人會被診斷出患有心理健康問題

cues.text: during their lifetime.
cues.en: during their lifetime.
cues.zh: 在他們的一生中。

cues.text: So why do we plan for one and are ashamed of the other?
cues.en: So why do we plan for one and are ashamed of the other?
cues.zh: 那麼，為什麼我們只為其中一個做好計劃，卻為另一個感到羞恥呢？

cues.text: What if we expected mental illness the same way we expect physical illness?
cues.en: What if we expected mental illness the same way we expect physical illness?
cues.zh: 如果我們像期待身體疾病一樣期待精神疾病呢？

cues.text: When you expect it, you're less ashamed when it arrives.
cues.en: When you expect it, you're less ashamed when it arrives.
cues.zh: 當你期待它時，當它到來時你就不會那麼羞愧了。

cues.text: You reach out sooner.
cues.en: You reach out sooner.
cues.zh: 你早點伸出援手。

cues.text: You get help faster and fewer people die.
cues.en: You get help faster and fewer people die.
cues.zh: 您可以更快地獲得幫助，並減少死亡人數。

cues.text: This is not abstract.
cues.en: This is not abstract.
cues.zh: 這並不抽象。

cues.text: The research is absolutely clear: talking about how you’re really doing with at least one person
cues.en: The research is absolutely clear: talking about how you’re really doing with at least one person
cues.zh: 這項研究絕對明確：談論你與至少一個人的真實表現

cues.text: greatly reduces suicide risk.
cues.en: greatly reduces suicide risk.
cues.zh: 大大降低自殺風險。

cues.text: Silence does not protect us.
cues.en: Silence does not protect us.
cues.zh: 沉默並不能保護我們。

cues.text: It isolates us.
cues.en: It isolates us.
cues.zh: 它使我們孤立。

cues.text: Shame creates silence.
cues.en: Shame creates silence.
cues.zh: 羞恥會帶來沉默。

cues.text: Silence creates isolation.
cues.en: Silence creates isolation.
cues.zh: 沉默會造成孤立。

cues.text: Isolation creates risk.
cues.en: Isolation creates risk.
cues.zh: 孤立會產生風險。

cues.text: I know because I lived that chain reaction.
cues.en: I know because I lived that chain reaction.
cues.zh: 我知道，因為我經歷了連鎖反應。

cues.text: And now, I'm dedicating my life and my resources
cues.en: And now, I'm dedicating my life and my resources
cues.zh: 現在，我奉獻我的生命和我的資源

cues.text: to starting a new chain.
cues.en: to starting a new chain.
cues.zh: 開始一個新的連鎖店。

cues.text: It’s called the “We are ENOUGH” giving chain.
cues.en: It’s called the “We are ENOUGH” giving chain.
cues.zh: 這就是所謂的「我們已經夠了」捐贈鏈。

cues.text: It started with me creating a simple beaded bracelet to wear every single day
cues.en: It started with me creating a simple beaded bracelet to wear every single day
cues.zh: 首先我製作了一款每天穿著的簡單串珠手鍊

cues.text: as a reminder to myself that I am enough.
cues.en: as a reminder to myself that I am enough.
cues.zh: 以此來提醒自己，我已經足夠了。

cues.text: But then, I realized something.
cues.en: But then, I realized something.
cues.zh: 但後來，我意識到了一些事情。

cues.text: The real power of this bracelet was not wearing it myself.
cues.en: The real power of this bracelet was not wearing it myself.
cues.zh: 這手鐲真正的威力並不在於我自己佩戴。

cues.text: It was sharing it with someone I love
cues.en: It was sharing it with someone I love
cues.zh: 與我愛的人分享

cues.text: so that they would know every day that I’ve got their back.
cues.en: so that they would know every day that I’ve got their back.
cues.zh: 這樣他們每天都會知道我在支援他們。

cues.text: That they're not alone.
cues.en: That they're not alone.
cues.zh: 他們並不孤單。

cues.text: That we are all enough.
cues.en: That we are all enough.
cues.zh: 我們都足夠了。

cues.text: And today, the way it works is simple.
cues.en: And today, the way it works is simple.
cues.zh: 今天，它的工作方式很簡單。

cues.text: Every person is given an ENOUGH bracelet, we ask them to send it to just one more person.
cues.en: Every person is given an ENOUGH bracelet, we ask them to send it to just one more person.
cues.zh: 每個人都得到了足夠的手鐲，我們要求他們再將其傳送給另外一個人。

cues.text: Now I’d like to ask you to do something with me real quickly.
cues.en: Now I’d like to ask you to do something with me real quickly.
cues.zh: 現在我想請你盡快幫我做點什麼。

cues.text: Please close your eyes.
cues.en: Please close your eyes.
cues.zh: 請閉上眼睛。

cues.text: And I'd like you to think of the one person in your life right now
cues.en: And I'd like you to think of the one person in your life right now
cues.zh: 我希望你現在想想你生命中的一個人

cues.text: that could use this message, or think of the one person in your life that has always made you feel enough.
cues.en: that could use this message, or think of the one person in your life that has always made you feel enough.
cues.zh: 可以使用這訊息，或是想想你生命中總是讓你感覺足夠的人。

cues.text: OK, open your eyes.
cues.en: OK, open your eyes.
cues.zh: 好吧，睜開眼睛。

cues.text: I ask that you take 60 seconds and send one to that person,
cues.en: I ask that you take 60 seconds and send one to that person,
cues.zh: 我要求你花 60 秒給那個人發一封，

cues.text: because if we all take this simple task and wear these bracelets,
cues.en: because if we all take this simple task and wear these bracelets,
cues.zh: 因為如果我們都承擔這個簡單的任務並戴上這些手鐲，

cues.text: I believe we will see a reduction in suicides
cues.en: I believe we will see a reduction in suicides
cues.zh: 我相信我們會看到自殺率下降

cues.text: and an improvement in our collective mental health.
cues.en: and an improvement in our collective mental health.
cues.zh: 以及我們集體心理健康的改善。

cues.text: And here's why.
cues.en: And here's why.
cues.zh: 原因如下。

cues.text: When you do not feel enough, you are constantly living in the past,
cues.en: When you do not feel enough, you are constantly living in the past,
cues.zh: 當你覺得不夠的時候，你就一直活在過去，

cues.text: obsessing over the mistakes that you've made and the shame and the guilt you carry because of them.
cues.en: obsessing over the mistakes that you've made and the shame and the guilt you carry because of them.
cues.zh: 沉迷於自己所犯的錯誤以及因此而承受的羞恥和罪惡感。

cues.text: And also, when you do not feel enough, and, very much like me, you're constantly living in the future
cues.en: And also, when you do not feel enough, and, very much like me, you're constantly living in the future
cues.zh: 而且，當你感覺不夠時，就像我一樣，你總是活在未來

cues.text: thinking, “What can I do, achieve or obtain to finally feel enough?”
cues.en: thinking, “What can I do, achieve or obtain to finally feel enough?”
cues.zh: 思考“我能做什麼、實現什麼或獲得什麼才能最終感覺足夠？”

cues.text: But when you start your day, and you ground your day in the fact that you are already enough,
cues.en: But when you start your day, and you ground your day in the fact that you are already enough,
cues.zh: 但當你開始新的一天，並以你已經足夠的事實為基礎，

cues.text: just as you are, you get to live in the present.
cues.en: just as you are, you get to live in the present.
cues.zh: 就像你一樣，你要活在當下。

cues.text: And almost every spiritual teacher throughout all of history
cues.en: And almost every spiritual teacher throughout all of history
cues.zh: 以及歷史上幾乎所有的精神導師

cues.text: agrees on only one thing: the only place we can access peace and joy consistently
cues.en: agrees on only one thing: the only place we can access peace and joy consistently
cues.zh: 只同意一件事：我們唯一能夠始終如一地獲得和平與歡樂的地方

cues.text: is in the present moment.
cues.en: is in the present moment.
cues.zh: 就在當下。

cues.text: Now, when you wear this bracelet, you are helping to destigmatize mental health.
cues.en: Now, when you wear this bracelet, you are helping to destigmatize mental health.
cues.zh: 現在，當您戴上這款手鍊時，您正在幫助消除心理健康的汙名。

cues.text: But I would say it's much more personal than that.
cues.en: But I would say it's much more personal than that.
cues.zh: 但我想說的是，這比這更個人化。

cues.text: When you wear this bracelet, you're sending a signal, a signal to those around you that says, “You can talk to me.
cues.en: When you wear this bracelet, you're sending a signal, a signal to those around you that says, “You can talk to me.
cues.zh: 當你戴上這個手鐲時，你就在向周圍的人發出一個訊號，一個訊號說：「你可以和我說話。

cues.text: You can tell me how you're really doing." And just that proven to save lives.
cues.en: You can tell me how you're really doing." And just that proven to save lives.
cues.zh: 你可以告訴我你的真實情況。 」事實證明，這一點可以拯救生命。

cues.text: Now my vision is not just about a bracelet.
cues.en: Now my vision is not just about a bracelet.
cues.zh: 現在我的願景不僅僅是手鐲。

cues.text: It’s about a world where we stop hiding.
cues.en: It’s about a world where we stop hiding.
cues.zh: 這是關於一個我們不再隱藏的世界。

cues.text: where we expect mental illness and respond care instead of shame.
cues.en: where we expect mental illness and respond care instead of shame.
cues.zh: 我們期待精神疾病並回應關懷而不是羞恥。

cues.text: And it's about a world where we tell each other how we're really doing,
cues.en: And it's about a world where we tell each other how we're really doing,
cues.zh: 這是一個我們互相告訴對方我們實際情況如何的世界，

cues.text: because honest conversation saves lives.
cues.en: because honest conversation saves lives.
cues.zh: 因為誠實的對話可以拯救生命。

cues.text: I'm here today because I reached out.
cues.en: I'm here today because I reached out.
cues.zh: 我今天來這裡是因為我伸出了援手。

cues.text: I'm also here because someone listened.
cues.en: I'm also here because someone listened.
cues.zh: 我來這裡也是因為有人傾聽。

cues.text: And I’m so, so thankful to be here today
cues.en: And I’m so, so thankful to be here today
cues.zh: 我非常非常感謝今天來到這裡

cues.text: to share this with you.
cues.en: to share this with you.
cues.zh: 與您分享。

cues.text: You are not broken.
cues.en: You are not broken.
cues.zh: 你沒有破碎。

cues.text: You are not weak.
cues.en: You are not weak.
cues.zh: 你並不弱。

cues.text: You're not alone.
cues.en: You're not alone.
cues.zh: 你並不孤單。

cues.text: You are enough, and you always will be.
cues.en: You are enough, and you always will be.
cues.zh: 你就足夠了，而且永遠都是。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。
